headword: {大同小異|だいどうしょうい}
gloss: essentially the same; mostly alike with minor differences

definitions.gloss: essentially the same; mostly alike with minor differences
definitions.explanation: Describing things that are fundamentally similar with only small, insignificant differences. Used when differences are negligible compared to the overall similarities.

examples.japanese: ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{大同小異|だいどうしょうい}だ。
examples.english: All the proposals are essentially the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大同小異|だいどうしょうい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The products from each company are mostly the same with no significant differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大同小異|だいどうしょうい}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The opinions were essentially the same, so we quickly reached an agreement.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO BREAKDOWN:
- {大|だい} - big, great
- ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ - same
- {小|しょう} - small
- ⟦{異|い}→異：01925_i⟧ - different

Literally: "big same, small different" = mostly the same with small differences.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大同小異|だいどうしょうい}だ - ~ are essentially the same
- {大同小異|だいどうしょうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun - essentially similar ~
- {大同小異|だいどうしょうい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - being essentially the same

USAGE:
Often used when:
- Comparing options that don't differ significantly
- Dismissing minor differences as unimportant  
- Noting that alternatives are interchangeable
- Finding common ground despite superficial differences
Can be:
- Neutral (stating a fact)
- Slightly dismissive (differences don't matter)
- Positive (finding agreement despite minor differences)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったり→似たり寄ったり：20438_nitariyottari⟧ - much the same, similar
- {五十歩百歩|ごじっぽひゃっぽ} - six of one, half dozen of the other
- どんぐり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背比|せいくら}べ - all much the same (humble things compared)
- ⟦{大差|たいさ}→大差：08410_taisa⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - no big difference

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Common in business and academic discussions.
